name: American Express Business Gold Card

welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: up to 200,000 Membership Rewards® points ("apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as 200,000") after you spend $15,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.
notes: 2026-11-13 as-high-as policy (lead decision): official Amex page (rendered GET 200, 9:36:08 PM PST): "APPLY AND FIND OUT YOUR WELCOME OFFER AS HIGH AS 200,000 Membership Rewards® Points after you spend $15,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 3 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer." (Annual Fee: $375, unchanged). Offer terms page (GET 200, 9:36:34 PM PST): "As High As 200,000 Membership Rewards® points Welcome Offer ... which will be an amount as high as 200,000 points ... after you spend $15,000 (the "Threshold Amount")". Variable amount, so not stored as a fixed bonus: bonus_points 200000 -> 0 with bonus_value 'Varies', bonus_points_max 200000, estimated_value 3400 removed, offer_status -> as_high_as_ymmv, is_elevated -> false (no limited-time/increased-offer wording for this card; the 'Limited Time Offer' tag on the page belongs to the Marriott Bonvoy Business nav item). Spend/months unchanged.
Previous description claimed a fixed 200,000 ('highest available sign-up bonus'); the official page shows only 'as high as 200,000'.

recurring_credits.name: Flexible Business Credit (FedEx / Grubhub / Office Supply)
recurring_credits.description: $20/month ($240/yr) on US purchases at FedEx, Grubhub, or office supply stores. Enrollment required.

recurring_credits.name: Squarespace Credit
recurring_credits.description: $150/yr on US Squarespace purchases. Added October 2025.

_excluded: Uber Cash — was wrongly listed previously; Amex Business Gold does NOT have an Uber Cash credit (consumer Gold + consumer Platinum + Biz Platinum do, not Biz Gold). Removed 2026-04-27.

rules.description: You may not be eligible to receive a welcome offer if you have or have had this Card or previous versions of this Card.

You also may not be eligible to receive a welcome offer based on various factors, such as your history with credit card balance transfers, your history as an American Express Card Member, the number of credit cards that you have opened and closed and other factors.
